document-converted.eventDescription: One document converted to Markdown, text or chunks (any size, any number of chunks). Failed documents are free.

ocr-page.eventDescription: One scanned PDF page read with OCR (only pages without a text layer, only when OCR is on).

image-ocr.eventDescription: One image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF or BMP) read with OCR into text or Markdown. A multi-page TIFF counts once. Failed images are free.
